description: This is a Java source file for an Android activity class named TextToSpeechActivity. It demonstrates the usage of the Android TextToSpeech API to synthesize speech, including initialization, language setting, speech synthesis, and resource cleanup.

classes.name: TextToSpeechActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that demonstrates text-to-speech functionality, including initializing the TTS engine, setting language, speaking phrases and handling activity lifecycle events.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and prepares the TextToSpeech engine. Also sets the click listener for the button.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Shuts down the TTS engine and performs cleanup when the activity is destroyed.

methods.name: onInit
methods.description: Callback invoked when the TextToSpeech engine has finished initializing. Sets the language and enables the button if successful.

methods.name: sayHello
methods.description: Selects a random greeting from the HELLOS array and speaks it through the TTS engine.
